seasons.mvpReasoning: No recap email exists for 2003 in Marc's inbox (exhaustively searched — only pre-season roster/dues logistics turned up), so this season was reconstructed directly from Yahoo's own archived league pages (still live at league ID 51959), which is more reliable than the generic-web fallback originally anticipated. Two wrinkles made 2003 unlike every other pre-2013 season: the league carried 14 teams that year (not 12 — confirmed via league settings and the 14 team names on the standings page), and scoring was an unusual variant (1 pt/completion, -0.5/incomplete, 0.5/reception, plus standard yardage/TD rates) that rewards QB volume far more than the eras this report otherwise covers. VOR baselines were rebuilt for this one season only (QB14/RB28/WR42/TE14, computed under the league's actual scoring from Pro-Football-Reference box scores) rather than reusing the standard QB12/RB24/WR36/TE12 non-flex baselines. Under those adjusted baselines, Priest Holmes's historic 27-touchdown season is still the clean VOR leader. No tiebreak applies: the champion (Cincinnati Hustler, Marc Muchnick, 7-6-0) owned Randy Moss, not a top-3 player, and the best regular-season record (Wildwood Old School, 10-3-0) owned none of the top-3 either — confirmed via Yahoo's 2003 draft results, final week-16 rosters, and full standings.
